interpretation.ambiguity_count_relation: This is the only distinct-lifetime overlap in the1033-record pilot definition index and there are no same-ID/same-known duplicates. It is therefore the identified structural source of the ambiguity path. The33241-minute attribution is the existing pilot report, not newly verified by per-minute joins.
interpretation.decision: Preserve frozen ambiguity and exclusions. Do not relax distinct-lifetime tests, collapse lifetime IDs, assign a roll mapping, or amend running admission outputs from this inference.
interpretation.inference: This pattern is consistent with an activation-date metadata revision of the same NQZ4 contract. It is not evidence of a different price scale; no tick change is present. However, metadata consistency alone is not a sourced correction/supersession contract.
interpretation.observed: One source raw ID/symbol/expiry/tick tuple acquires a different historical activation timestamp in consecutive source-row regimes. All records are individually admitted quarter-tick records; no delete/invalid block separates regimes. Strict identity includes activation, so two active lifetime identities coexist once the newer record is known.

overlap.clock_scope: This is the possible ambiguity interval for bars bearing this raw ID, not a claim every clock minute is observed or the continuous series still chooses NQZ4 until expiry.

pilot_reported_price_quality_reference.scope: Copied from already retained pilot result. No price-table scan or independent minute-count reconstruction.

review_scope: Only retained pilot worker JSON and admitted definition artifact metadata. No source data Parquet, raw or canonical price table, fixture, test, candidate import, compilation, study run, or source/test/tool edit.
unavailable_facts: Admitted per-record metadata retains raw_fields_sha256 but not the actual security_update_action, event timestamp, provider receipt, or a prior-version supersession pointer. The schema lists these fields but their row values are not present in the permitted artifact.
A raw-field hash proves identity against source bytes; it does not disclose whether row228 action isA/M or whether activation was explicitly corrected.
No provider/venue correction notice or explicit statement that the historical activation field is erroneous is retained here.
The exact33241 affected minute identities were not re-read in this metadata-only review.
what_could_distinguish_revision_without_: An actual source/provider correction contract tying the update to the same raw contract and explicitly superseding the prior activation field, with the update known-at and exact source bytes.

If supplied source update actionM has documented semantics that revise this same raw instrument lifetime rather than allocate a new one, retain its actual row value and relevant source rule; actionM alone without that interpretation is not a new identity mapping.

Any future correction-aware identity rule must be separately versioned and tested against genuine distinct-symbol/expiry/reused-ID overlap cases, and applied only after its known-at. Earlier rows must not receive future correction knowledge. Current registered evidence remains unchanged.
